name: What is an uninsured motorist accident lawyer?
description: An uninsured motorist accident lawyer helps people injured by drivers without insurance to recover compensation from their own insurance policy.

mainEntity.name: What is an uninsured motorist accident lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: An uninsured motorist accident lawyer helps individuals who have been injured in a car accident by a driver without car insurance or with insufficient insurance coverage. These lawyers navigate the complexities of filing a claim against your own insurance policy's uninsured/underinsured motorist (UM/UIM) coverage, or pursuing other avenues for compensation. They ensure your rights are protected and work to maximize your recovery for medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering.
